MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)

   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

20. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.

22. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

----
